project_context.name: FrasaTwist
project_context.strict_rule: Do NOT modify the existing application workflow, API logic, or core paraphrasing functions. Apply changes ONLY to UI presentation and CSS animation classes.

typography.headings: Sans-serif, bold, uppercase, tight tracking (e.g., '3D VIRTUOSO' style from reference)
typography.body: Sans-serif, regular weight, high legibility for academic reading

visual_rules.shapes: Pill-shaped (fully rounded) buttons and tags. Large corner radius for main cards.
visual_rules.borders: Clean, thin borders (1px solid #E5E7EB) on light elements to separate them from the background.
visual_rules.shadows: Clean, distinct drop shadows (no heavy blur) to create separation between the Z-layers. Example: `shadow-[0_12px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)`
visual_rules.textures: None. 100% solid colors. No glassmorphism, no backdrop-blur, no transparency on surfaces.

antigravity_effect.behavior: Continuous, subtle vertical floating (translateY up and down by 4px-8px) using CSS @keyframes.
antigravity_effect.timing: Slow, ease-in-out curve (4-6 seconds per cycle) so it feels like weightless drifting, not bouncing.
antigravity_effect.staggering: Apply different `animation-delay` values to separate UI elements (like tags or cards) so they float independently out of sync.
antigravity_effect.interaction: On hover, the element stops floating, translates slightly upward, and increases its shadow depth to simulate being picked up.

component_mapping.primary_buttons: Solid black or heavy dark grey background, white text, pill shape.
component_mapping.tags_and_chips: White background, thin border, floating animation, black text.
component_mapping.content_cards: Solid lavender or white background, rounded corners, soft distinct shadow to indicate elevation.
